pages.description: Software and icon licenses, with required attribution.
pages.content:
Technologies & Licenses

FetchFolio's original theme code and content are distributed under the GNU General Public License v3.0. The repository includes the full license text.

WordPress

This theme runs on WordPress and uses its PHP theme APIs, editor, and database-backed pages and posts. WordPress itself is licensed under GPL version 2 or later. WordPress is installed separately and is not bundled in this theme directory.

Icons

GitHub, YouTube, and Discord

These brand marks are adapted from Simple Icons. The Simple Icons project is released under CC0 1.0. Brand names and logos remain the property of their respective owners; their use here does not imply endorsement.

LinkedIn

The LinkedIn SVG is from Font Awesome Free 6.5.2 by Fonticons, Inc. It is used under CC BY 4.0. Attribution: LinkedIn icon by Fonticons, Inc. (Font Awesome Free 6.5.2).

MakerWorld and License

These two small SVGs are original FetchFolio artwork. MakerWorld is a trademark of its respective owner.

Other components

The theme uses the browser's built-in HTML, CSS, and JavaScript support and WordPress core APIs. It does not bundle the static version's marked.js or js-yaml libraries. The theme's monospace text uses fonts already available on the visitor's system; no font files are bundled.

Optional plugins

The preview environment uses WP Consent API and WP Statistics. Neither plugin is bundled with the FetchFolio theme ZIP. Each plugin retains its own license and notices; consult its WordPress.org listing and installed package for details.

posts.title: Welcome to the FetchFolio blog
posts.excerpt: A terminal-native space for notes, guides and project updates.
posts.content:
FetchFolio now has a small, file-based blog for development notes, guides and project updates.

How it works

Each post is a Markdown file under content/blog/. The index.json file is the catalogue used by the blog index, so adding a post only requires a new Markdown file and one catalogue entry.

This keeps the site fast, portable and easy to edit: there is no database, build pipeline or admin panel to maintain.

New posts can be published by committing the Markdown file and its catalogue entry.
